title: Deliver Prospectus at its private Cyclotron domain through CI/CD
description:
As a brand operator, I want a separately delivered Prospectus app so public sites integrate through configured links or narrow intake without hosting CRM data.

Feature: Separate Prospectus delivery
  Scenario: Reproducible delivery
    Given reviewed source, passing required CI checks and approved platform access
    When the established Cyclotron delivery workflow runs for Prospectus
    Then it builds and deploys the app and writable backend to the verified dedicated account
    And https://prospectus.cyclotron.anth.us serves valid TLS and the expected build
    And other Cyclotron sites remain unchanged
  Scenario: Verify the deployed writable path
    Given an authorized CRM user at the deployed domain
    When they create and progress a prospect then reload in a fresh session
    Then the same issue and updated stage are loaded from canonical storage
    And the verification report distinguishes source checks from live evidence
  Scenario: Block safely on unavailable platform access
    Given expired credentials or an unapproved persistent access change
    When delivery reaches that prerequisite
    Then the exact prerequisite is reported without changing accounts or bypassing approval

comments.author: home
comments.text: Local preparation authorized: remove the application-forced custom CDK bootstrap qualifier and separate deployment bootstrap template; use standard Amplify Gen2 service-role setup and the account bootstrap. Given the approved Prospectus app and standard account bootstrap, when the backend is synthesized locally, then it uses standard bootstrap asset/deployment references without requiring app-specific bootstrap roles. Given deployment authorization is pending and Google OAuth remains uncreated, when local checks run, then no AWS resources, policies or role assignments change. The existing marketing execution-policy restriction is configuration evidence; there has been no Prospectus deployment job or demonstrated deployment error. Changes and tracking remain local and unpushed.
